text:
Mq1 is the asymmetric element: W=3.889 versus 25.92 for Mq0 and Mq2.

This is a current-starved ring oscillator. The PMOS current sources (Mq*) mirror Mb2. Mb2 carries the current set by Mb1 from vctrl. With Mq1 about 6.7× weaker, stage 1 can only source a fraction of the reference current. Its rising edge is therefore slow and limited by Mq1, independent of the tuning current.

At low vctrl the reference current is small, and the starved stage fails to oscillate or switch fully, so f_lo is n/a and the tuning ratio fails. f_hi and f_mid are still met.
